{{Quote|One extremely intoxicated enlisted trooper attempted to eat 50 Spiced Mynock Wings from the buffet.|Official reprimand from Eastern Arch Platoon Leader Ton E'rau to TK-934|<ref name="Force Unleashed II" />}}
A '''Spiced Mynock Wing''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]<ref name="Force Unleashed II" /> that shared its named with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non–sentient]] [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> By around [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="Syrox Redeption Date">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'' states that [[Waleed Nagma]] first arrived at [[Cog Hive Seven]] three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events in ''Maul: Lockdown''. [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]] sets the events of ''Maul: Lockdown'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] and Nagma's arrival is depicted during the events in "[[The Syrox Redemption]]". Thus "The Syrox Redeption" must take place around [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dakarai Blirr]] had [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] a Spiced Mynock Wing to a [[Unidentified Cyblocian assassin|Cyblocian assassin]] for his [[Reproduction/Legends|birthday]] while the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Syrox Redeption" /> 

At somepoint between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' established that the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] was established by at the start of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occured in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], per the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] must have eaten the Spiced Mynock Wing at the [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]] between those two [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] falsifying their ranks in order to visited the [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. While there one intoxicated [[Unidentified enlisted trooper|trooper]] attempted to eat fifty Spiced Mynock Wings and later made a mess that left the interior of a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] out of commission for several [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Following the incident [[Eastern Arch Platoon]] leader [[Ton E'rau]] filed an official reprimand to the individual in charge of the group stormtroopers, [[TK-934]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spiced Mynock Wings were first mentioned in "The [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]" databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II" />
